literal_translation: mieć podobne zdanie, zgadzać się z kimś
example: My sister and I don't always see eye to eye on music.
origin: Thought to come from the idea of two people looking at something from the same angle; the exact origin is uncertain

wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom is about opinions, not eyesight
The idiom describes agreement, not avoidance
The idiom is about agreeing or disagreeing in general, not about money or loud arguments

explanation: 'See eye to eye' means that two people have the same opinion. It is often used in the negative, to talk about people who disagree about something.
